core_principles: Keep the heel of the front (dominant) leg flat on the ground at all times during the lunge.
Lunge forward to a standardized distance of approximately 75% of the dominant leg length.
common_mistakes: Lifting the heel of the front (dominant) leg off the ground during the lunge.
specific_findings: Subjects performed lunges forward to a marked distance equaling 75% of the subject's dominant leg length.
Keeping the heel of the dominant leg on the ground at all times is required to prevent excessive patellofemoral stress.
